summary: First Eagle Private Credit Fund, a Delaware closed-end fund (BDC election, file 814-01642), filed an 8-K under Items 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01 on September 21, 2026, disclosing September distributions of $0.210 per Class I share and $0.210 gross ($0.205 net) per Class D share, payable September 30 to holders of record and paid October 29, 2026, plus August 31, 2026 NAV of $23.74 per share for both classes, aggregate NAV of $294.9 million, portfolio fair value of $531.4 million, weighted average tenor 3.63 years, approximately $263.6 million principal debt outstanding, and 0.89x debt-to-equity. The filing also updates its continuous public offering of up to $5.0 billion in common shares and a separate unregistered private offering, with 12,417,916 Class I and 4,205 Class D shares outstanding. This is routine fund disclosure with no special-situations event; no deal terms or advisor named.
